en: Hello... Lovely weather, isn't it? I must have dozed off in the sunshine.
I'm Erika, the Leader of this Gym. I study flower arranging, and my Pokémon are all of the Grass type.
Oh, you want to battle me? Very well. I shan't lose, though.
Oh... I concede. You are remarkably strong. Please, take the Rainbow Badge.
{player} received the Rainbow Badge from Erika!
With the Rainbow Badge, your Pokémon can use Strength outside of battle, to push heavy boulders.
Please accept this as well. It's a move I'm very fond of.
TM19 is Giga Drain. It takes the foe's strength and gives half of it back to your Pokémon.
Losing to you was no disgrace. I must devote myself to my studies of flowers and of battle.
Celadon City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Erika. Winning trainers: {rival}.
Celadon City Pokémon Gym. Leader: Erika. Winning trainers: {rival}, {player}.
